home.tagline: The unified exam platform for secondary education
home.topStudentSubtitle: The highest scorer in the platform
home.bottomCtaSubtitle: Create your account and join our community of students.
home.featuresSubtitle: Learn, practice, and track your progress in one place
home.featureTelegramDesc: Become a member through Telegram, get notified about approvals and results, and stay in touch with the platform.
home.featureLeaderboardDesc: Compete with your peers and see who tops the ranking by XP every week, month, and all time.
home.featureAutoDesc: MCQ quizzes are graded instantly. Essay answers are reviewed and approved by admins with detailed feedback.
home.featureStatsDesc: Track your average score, completed quizzes, XP, and level with an AI-powered performance analysis.
home.faqSubtitle: Answers to the most common questions
home.faq1q: How do I create an account?
home.faq1a: Tap “Create Account”, fill in your details, and choose your study track. You can also register faster using your Telegram account.
home.faq2q: Why do I need to verify my membership?
home.faq2a: Verification keeps the community authentic. You provide two screenshots to confirm you follow our Telegram channel and group, and an admin approves your account.
home.faq3q: How are my quiz results graded?
home.faq3a: Multiple choice questions are graded automatically and instantly. Essay answers are reviewed by admins, and once your attempt is approved you earn XP.
home.faq4a: The leaderboard ranks students by the XP they earn from approved attempts. You can view weekly, monthly, and all-time rankings.
home.faq5q: What is the AI performance analysis?
home.faq5a: After completing quizzes, an AI report analyzes your results, highlights your best subject, and gives personalized guidance to improve.
